# Tact attribution

The Nanocodex2 terminal interface is derived from the Tact 0.6.6 source at
`clabby/tact@a2de8ae1e0b6ce8d8f0a251a9d681dc430b247aa`.

Tact is licensed under Apache License 2.0. The complete upstream license is in
[`LICENSE.md`](LICENSE.md). Imported Rust files carry a notice that Nanocodex2
modifies the upstream work. Nanocodex2 replaces Tact's local agent engine and
authentication with the account-authenticated Nanocodex managed-agent
lifecycle; the pinned Tact terminal behavior remains the parity authority.
